run_delta1_metric: run delta1_metric to compute reward scores by comparing model answers against ground truth solutions using delta-1 tolerance
test_delta1_metric: test delta1_metric with lists of contents and solutions to verify symbolic and string matching reward computation
review_delta1_metric: review delta1_metric which uses math_verify parse and regex to extract answers and check within 25% ratio tolerance
refactor_delta1_metric: refactor delta1_metric to support additional verification methods beyond symbolic parsing and answer tag extraction
summarize_METRIC_CLASSES: summarize METRIC_CLASSES dictionary which maps metric names like delta1_metric to their corresponding callable functions
